item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Dang, this was good. I am a bit of a sucker for most things CotBG, but this is all very well put together.

+ Probably Spoilers
- Probably Spoilers

I thought that the setup(the Book of Horrors) was quite well done. It had the ring of the CotBG, and oddly, left a King James Bible "aftertaste". Not that that's a bad thing…
I definitely liked the chatlog. I'm not sure quite what happened to SoThenMyDad, but that may well be the author's intent. That PL temporarily stopped his heart(or something like that) seems likely to me.
The two PL reports are well put together, and served quite well as the lead-up to the last tab. That brought it home for me. It really felt genuine.
I had also thought the last tab might have been a tie-in to the SCP-148 containment/retrieval log, but on reading the article, I don't find anything that it actually seems to tie into. Whatever. It's still very well done.

Upvoted.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Super cool! The Colossus (SCP-2406) was also built with Orichalcum but went by an estimated admixture of metals because I felt the Foundation wouldn't use the term, so aimed for the hypothesized materials that would be part of that alloy.

I've actually wanted to do something with the Church of Maxwell - despite their modern trappings, I feel they are a return to the goals of the original church, a broader passion for technological progress. Steam and gears but one step in our journey to perfection:)

Err, sorry, rambling. Anyway. Really enjoyed this. In my mind, MEKHANE has no set gender - being a purely mechanical entity, but referred to as he or she as anthropomorphism - humanizing something otherwise quite alien from us.

item.title: Access>> Root >> Author Commentary
item.content:encoded:
This was my original idea for the February Reimagination Contest… which got shot down by the contest runners because it didn't fulfill the requirements. Insert rant here.

This was made using Randomini's CYOA module, and all the documents are on one page because it was the format used for the Reimagining Contest, and I Can't Be Bothered to change it. Plus, I don't want to flood recently created with Four of Five pages in this.

Thanks to everyone who may or may not have looked at this on chat a few months back. I forget your names because I am a pile of something that is the same color and shape as a pile of chocolate pudding, but has a significantly worse taste. That's right: BLACK PUDDING!
